responsibility: This implementation module provides the executive’s timer process, relative-timed event queues, and basic round-robin scheduling policy. It maintains total tick count and current quantum state, creates and recycles EVENT records, inserts/removes them on active and free queues using relative timeout accounting, resumes waiting processes when events expire or are cancelled, supports Sleep/WaitOn/ReArmEvent/Cancel, optionally pulses keyboard LEDs for activity indication, and starts a dedicated Timer process that integrates RTint time vectors with Executive process control to preempt or rotate runnable tasks after a configurable quantum.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the working implementation behind TimerHandler.def: it defines the EVENT record and queue types, maintains active/dead relative-timer queues and tick/quanta state, starts the dedicated Timer process, and implements expiration, cancellation, and runnable-process rotation logic that the .def file only announces.
